patterns.note: The hero section employs a split-screen layout where the left side contains prominent textual content and CTAs, while the right side features dynamic, interactive dashboard-like visuals on a dark background.

A high-contrast dark theme (near-black) is consistently used for most content sections, punctuated by a light, off-white background for the hero's left panel and specific callout sections, creating visual breaks.
Headings are set in an extremely large, bold sans-serif typeface, creating a strong visual hierarchy and impact, especially in the hero and section titles.

The main navigation bar transforms upon scroll: it starts with a transparent background over the hero, then shrinks slightly and gains a solid dark background as the user scrolls down, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport.

The hero section features a distinct split-scroll effect where the left textual content scrolls normally with the page, while the right visual panel appears to have a fixed background or slower scroll speed, creating a subtle parallax-like depth.

technique_notes: To achieve the sticky navigation, the header element should be positioned absolutely over the hero, then transition to a fixed position with a solid background and reduced height/padding once the user scrolls past a certain threshold.

The split-screen hero can be built using a grid or flexbox layout. The left content panel scrolls with the document flow, while the right visual panel uses a fixed background attachment or a separate scrollable container with a slower scroll rate to create the parallax effect relative to the left content.

The site uses a dark base theme with a vibrant accent color. This can be implemented by setting a dark primary background color and a contrasting light text color, with a bright, saturated color reserved for interactive elements like buttons and links.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual impact, complemented by a clear, readable sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (small border-radius) is applied consistently to buttons, cards, and input fields, providing a soft, modern feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing is used throughout, with an airy hero section that gives way to a more structured, balanced density in content grids and feature sections.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its dynamic, split-screen hero section that combines impactful typography with interactive, dashboard-like visuals, creating an immediate sense of sophistication and technical capability. The strong contrast between the dark theme and the vibrant teal accent also makes it visually memorable.
